KISWAHILI ACTIVITIES — TERMLY EXAM #4
====

GRADE: Grade 3
SUBJECT: KISWAHILI ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Maagano, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Maagano.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Maagano.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Maagano.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Maagano.

2. When practising Hadithi, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Hadithi.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Hadithi.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Hadithi.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Hadithi.

3. When practising upatiwa kadi za nambari 51-100, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to upatiwa kadi za nambari 51-100.
   B. Use insults to “practise” upatiwa kadi za nambari 51-100.
   C. Copy random text without understanding upatiwa kadi za nambari 51-100.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for upatiwa kadi za nambari 51-100.

4. Wingi wa “mtoto” ni: (1 mark)
   A. mato
   B. watoto
   C. kitoto
   D. mitoto

5. When practising Masimulizi, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Masimulizi.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Masimulizi.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Masimulizi.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Masimulizi.

6. When practising nyakati, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for nyakati.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to nyakati.
   C. Use insults to “practise” nyakati.
   D. Copy random text without understanding nyakati.

7. When practising Usalama, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Usalama.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Usalama.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Usalama.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Usalama.

8. Kinyume cha “refu” ni: (1 mark)
   A. pana
   B. nene
   C. zito
   D. fupi

9. Ni sentensi ipi iliyo sahihi kisarufi? (1 mark)
   A. Anasoma mwanafunzi kitabu ya.
   B. Kitabu anasoma mwanafunzi kwa.
   C. Mwanafunzi anasoma vitabu mzuri.
   D. Mwanafunzi anasoma kitabu.

10. When practising Msamiati, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Msamiati.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Msamiati.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Msamiati.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Msamiati.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
11. In three clear sentences, explain Hadithi and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

12. In three clear sentences, explain Masimulizi and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

13. In three clear sentences, explain Dukani and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Masimulizi and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Hadithi and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Nimpendaye and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
